title: Chapter 308 - 308 Sent An E-Mail; Review It Asap!
content:
Chapter 308 - 308 Sent An E-Mail; Review It Asap!

Chapter 308 - 308 Sent An E-mail; Review It ASAP!

308 Sent An E-mail; Review It ASAP!

Lin Fan sighed helplessly. “What I meant was to change your name to Lil White and not Lil White Then.”

The screen of the super smart watch flashed for a moment before a crisp sound came out.

“Ding! Modification successful! Lil White And Not Lil White Then at your service.”

When Lin Fan heard this, his lips twitched.

Idiot!

This was definitely a super silly watch!

Lin Fan patiently explained it to the super smart watch.

That was how he changed its name to Lil White.

Lin Fan then went to the washroom. When he passed by the study, he happened to see a stack of documents on the table.

Out of curiosity, he casually glanced at it.

“Super battery patent.”

Lin Fan muttered, “Did the mission rewards come straight to my house? That’s quite convenient.”

Then, he looked at the computer beside him and said, “Anyway, I don’t have anything else to do, so I’ll just write the thesis on this super battery first.”

If an ordinary person wanted to write a thesis, they would definitely have to think twice. After all, it was an extremely difficult task.

After spending a lot of time writing it, one still had to go through complicated and detailed modifications.

However, Lin Fan was different. This thesis was given to him by the system.

It could be said that it was directly engraved into his mind. There was no need for any thought or modification at all. It was incomparably perfect.

Lin Fan’s fingers were on the keyboard, jumping around like a phantom.

In just over an hour…

A logically meticulous and extremely complicated thesis appeared in the Word document.

Lin Fan pondered for a while and wrote his name in the first author’s position. Then, he wrote Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa in the second author’s position.

Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa were the two professors who asked their students to do the battery experiment for him.

Lin Fan was a person who knew how to repay kindness.

Some small benefits?

This was a thesis on super batteries!

If Zhao Xueqin and Li Rongfa knew about this, who knew how shocked they would be?

Of course, regarding this…

Lin Fan did not care.

He casually sent the thesis to the editorial department of Science.

When he was about to leave the study, he saw the super smart watch on his wrist.

Hence, Lin Fan said, “Lil White, can you get my thesis approved in the shortest time possible?”

As one of the most authoritative scientific research magazines in the world, Science was the holy land in the hearts of all scientific researchers. They received countless emails every day.

For most scholars, successfully publishing a paper in Science was something they were extremely proud of. In fact, they could even make a meteoric rise immediately.

Therefore, the email of the editor of Science was filled with endless manuscripts all year round.

Lin Fan had sent the manuscript over. Under normal circumstances, it would take at least a week or two before it could be reviewed.

That was why he asked the super smart watch.

“No problem, Master!”

The screen of the super smartwatch flashed slightly and emitted a crisp and pleasant sound.

…

In America…

At this time, it was early in the morning.

Science’s editor, Howard Theus, was lying on a soft bed with a faint smile on his face. Clearly, he was having a good dream.

At this moment, the phone beside his bed suddenly rang.

However, the noise did not wake Howard up.

The next moment, the TV in his room suddenly turned on automatically and switched on the sound system that he had not used in a long time.

Howard was so frightened that he jumped out of bed.

“What happened? What’s wrong?”

When he saw that it was the TV, he heaved a sigh of relief.

“I remember that I turned it off before I went to bed. Did I remember wrongly?”

Howard shook his head and did not care too much.

He picked up the remote control by the bed and turned it off. Then, he lay back on the bed.

However, he had only laid down for a while when the TV and sound system were turned on again, and a series of ear-splitting sounds were heard.

Howard jumped up again and shouted, “F*ck! Is this TV crazy? I’ll throw it into the trash tomorrow!”

After saying that, Howard stood up angrily and pulled out the power cord.

After going through the trouble, Howard felt a little thirsty.

He got up and went to the kitchen. He poured a glass of ice water and gulped it down.

Then, he returned to his room to continue sleeping.

At this moment…

The oven, which would only make a sound after it was done roasting something, made continuous ringing noises.

The washing machine, which only played light music after washing clothes, kept playing light music.

The refrigerator door, which would only make a sound when it was not closed even after a long time, produced an urgent beeping sound…

All the electrical appliances that could make sounds rang at this moment.

It was extremely noisy and hurried!

Howard held his head and shouted, “What the f*ck?! What’s going on?”

Then, he quickly unplugged all the electrical appliances.

Just as Howard heaved a sigh of relief, the laptop in the study started playing loud music.

He quickly walked into the study and raised his hand to turn off the laptop.

However, Howard soon realized that he could not control the mouse at all.

Even if the power was unplugged, the laptop still ran on its battery.

Howard shouted angrily, “If I find out who’s playing this prank on me, I’ll definitely make them pay!”

At this moment, the music on the laptop suddenly stopped.

At the same time, an email popped up on the screen.

‘Principles and Applications of Super Batteries.’

Howard, who was in a state of anger, only glanced at it casually at first.

Not long after, however, he could not take his eyes off it.

“This… This… Could such a small battery continuously release so much electricity?

“If this thesis is true…

“Super battery…

“Super batteries will definitely change the entire mobile phone electronics industry!

“Whose article is this? Lin Fan from Jiangbei University? The mathematician and the genius who invented the earthquake prediction device?

“Oh my God!”

Now, Lin Fan’s name could be said to be well-known in the scientific research world.

At this moment, Howard had completely forgotten about the unpleasantness from before. He was extremely excited.

If it was Lin Fan, the value of this thesis would rise to another level.

“I have to ask the managing editor for permission and then look for a big shot in the industry to review it…”

Then, Howard ignored the abnormality of the electrical appliances in the house and the sky that had yet to completely brighten up. He took out his phone and dialed the number of the managing editor.

…
